note: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba (the Caribbean Netherlands) keep the Kingdom's Caribbean list (Jamaicans, exempt for Curaçao only, need a visa, as the list has it).

sources.title: NetherlandsWorldwide (Government of the Netherlands), Do I need a visa for the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom?
sources.said: You can travel to the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom (Aruba, Bonaire, Curaçao, Saba, St Eustatius and St Maarten) without a visa if any of the following applies to you. ... Jamaica: Curaçao only. You do need a visa for the other Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
